241K likes, 4,331 comments - realhimesh on October 14, 2026: "Jai MATADI Let’s Rock 🙏❤️. After two smashing blockbuster hits, #YehPremMolLiya and the superhit  #JaiAmbeBol, which have collectively crossed 250 million views across all platforms and over 100 million views on the YouTube channel of Himesh Reshammiya Melodies here another celebration anthem Jhumka  Patola ❤️

Sung by the melodious #ShreyaGhoshal and written by sonia kapoor reshammiya @soniakapoor06 #JhumkaPatola  celebrates the beautiful gifts of pariwaar aur prem, bringing love, family and togetherness to the festive season! ❤️🎶
